name: Odin, Ruler of Asgard
effect:
1 "Nordic Ascendant" Tuner + 1+ non tuner monster
Must first be Synchro Summoned.
This card is always treated as an “Aesir” monster.
- (Quick Effect): When your opponent activates a card or effect: You can send 1 card from your hand to the  GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.
- If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 “Nordic” Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand.
- If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 “Aesir” monster from your GY or Extra Deck, except “Odin, Ruler of Asgard”.
You can only use each effect of “Odin, Ruler of Asgard” once per turn.
